newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega shares rise on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Sega shares rise on bargain hunting.

text.p: Shares in Sega Enterprises Ltd rose sharply on Thursday morning, helped by bargain hunting, brokers said.
The share price was up 150 yen at 3,460 yen at 0128 GMT, making it the eighth largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Volume was 135,200 shares.
Sega, which makes amusement products, has come under selling pressure since it announced last month that it would merge with Bandai Co Ltd.

"After the announcement of its merger with Bandai, Sega's shares had been weaker. But the prospect that the merger may creat positive effects is prompting buying on dips," said a trader at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
